Create a complete, production-ready single HTML file (HTML+CSS+vanilla JS all inline, no frameworks/libraries) implementing a premium cinematic "ARTIFACT: Museum Night" event landing page. This is a brand new file — generate the full document from scratch (doctype, head, body, closing tags).

=== SEO / META (in <head>) ===
- <title>ARTIFACT: Museum Night — Ticketed After-Hours Museum Event</title>
- meta description
- Open Graph title, description, og:image (use https://source.unsplash.com/featured/2400x1400?museum,night as og:image)
- meta viewport
- inline SVG favicon as data URI (e.g. a gold circle/spotlight icon on dark bg) via <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,...">

=== GLOBAL STYLE (all inline in <style> in <head>) ===
CSS custom properties for palette:
--bg:#070506; --velvet:#1a0710; --burgundy:#3a0f1d; --navy:#07111f; --gold:#d6ad60; --soft-gold:#f3d79b; --ivory:#f8efe2; --muted:#b9a999; --panel:rgba(255,244,220,0.06); --border:rgba(214,173,96,0.28)

Headline font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif. Body font-family: Inter, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif (add Google font fallback stack only, no external font link needed since strict no-libraries — just use system stacks).

Body background: near-black with deep burgundy + midnight navy radial/linear gradients layered, fixed spotlight radial-gradient effects (soft gold glow spots at various fixed positions using background or ::before on body/hero).
Add a subtle CSS-only grain/noise overlay: a fixed full-viewport pseudo-element with a repeating-linear-gradient or tiny SVG data-uri noise pattern at low opacity (e.g. 0.05), mix-blend-mode overlay, pointer-events:none, z-index high.

Thin gold dividers: hr-like elements or ::after borders using var(--border), 1px, with gradient fade at edges (linear-gradient transparent -> gold -> transparent).

Glass-like dark panels: background var(--panel), backdrop-filter: blur(10px), border:1px solid var(--border), border-radius ~16px.

Strong typography hierarchy: hero h1 ~clamp(2.8rem,6vw,5.5rem), section h2 ~clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem), etc. Smooth hover transitions (transform, box-shadow, color) 0.3s ease on buttons/cards/links.

scroll-behavior: smooth on html.

=== 1. NAVBAR ===
Fixed/sticky top nav, semi-transparent dark glass background that becomes more opaque on scroll (JS toggles a class on scroll).
- Logo text "ARTIFACT" in gold serif, letter-spaced.
- Nav links: Program, Artists, Venue, Tickets, FAQ — each anchor to section ids (#program #artists #venue #tickets #faq), smooth scroll via JS click handler (e.preventDefault + scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})).
- Active nav-link state highlighted (gold underline/color) driven by IntersectionObserver watching each section, toggling .active class on corresponding nav link.
- CTA button "Get Tickets" (gold filled button) scrolls to #tickets.
- Mobile hamburger menu button (pure CSS/JS, no libs) that toggles a slide-down/slide-in mobile nav panel; closes on link click and on outside click.

=== 2. HERO (#hero) ===
Full-viewport (min-height:100vh) cinematic section.
- Background image https://source.unsplash.com/featured/2400x1400?museum,night as background-image on the section (with background-size:cover, background-position:center).
- Dark overlay: linear-gradient(rgba(7,5,6,.55), rgba(7,5,6,.92)) plus a radial "spotlight" gradient (soft gold radial-gradient at ~40% 30%) layered on top via ::before/::after.
- Small uppercase metadata badges row (pill shapes, glass panel style) showing "18 October 2026", "19:00–02:00", "The Old Gallery, Warsaw" with small icon glyphs (unicode symbols like ✦ 📍 🕘 are fine as plain text, no external icon lib).
- Eyebrow label "ARTIFACT: Museum Night" in gold small-caps/letterspaced text above headline.
- Large serif headline: "Museum Night, Reimagined" (this is the h1).
- Supporting paragraph one line.
- Two CTA buttons: "Get Tickets" (solid gold, scrolls to #tickets) and "Save to Calendar" (outlined ghost button, id="saveCalendarBtn", triggers JS .ics download — no href).
- subtle scroll-down indicator/chevron animated bounce at bottom of hero.

=== 3. CONCEPT / INTRO (#concept) ===
- Section heading + short 2-3 sentence editorial paragraph about the event (evocative museum-at-night copy).
- 3 feature cards in a responsive grid (glass panel style, gold icon or numeral, hover lift): "After-Hours Exhibitions", "Live Performances", "Guided Hidden-Room Tours" each with short descriptive text.
- All cards and heading have class="reveal" for scroll-reveal animation (see JS section).

=== 4. PROGRAM TIMELINE (#program) ===
Vertical timeline with a central/left gold line (::before on container, 1-2px gradient gold line) and 8 timeline items each with a gold dot/node marker, alternating or left-aligned layout (responsive: single column on mobile):
19:00 Doors Open; 19:30 Curator Welcome; 20:00 Hidden Collection Tour; 21:00 Live Ambient Performance; 22:00 Sculpture Hall Projection; 23:00 Artist Talk; 00:00 Midnight Gallery Walk; 01:00 Closing Sound Session.
Each item: time (gold, serif or mono-ish), title (h3 serif), short one-sentence description, small location tag (pill, e.g. "Main Hall", "East Wing", "Sculpture Court", "Rooftop", "Auditorium", "Archive Room", "Grand Atrium", "Sound Lab" — assign sensibly). Add class="reveal" to each item.

=== 5. ARTISTS / SPEAKERS (#artists) ===
Responsive grid of 8 artist cards (asymmetric sizing allowed via grid-row/col spans on a couple of cards for editorial feel). Each card: image (use these 6 URLs cycling/reused across 8 cards: 
1 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?gallery,art
2 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?exhibition,lights
3 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?sculpture,museum
4 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?museum,crowd
5 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?art,installation
6 https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?theater,stage
), name, role (e.g. Curator, Sound Artist, Sculptor, Lighting Designer, Performance Artist, Photographer, Installation Artist, Composer), short one-line teaser, "View details" button with data-attributes (data-name, data-role, data-image, data-bio, data-time) or reference an index into a JS array ARTISTS. Clicking opens the artist modal.
Invent 8 distinct fictional artist names/bios suited to the theme.

Artist modal (id="artistModal"): hidden by default (display:none / class toggle), role="dialog" aria-modal="true", contains image, name, role, longer bio paragraph, "Session: <time>" line, close "✕" button (id="artistModalClose"). Close on: close button click, ESC key (keydown listener), backdrop click (click on the modal overlay outside the panel). Trap basic focus not required but keep it accessible (aria-label on close button, focus the modal panel on open).

=== 6. VENUE (#venue) ===
Two-column layout: left = text info panel (venue name "The Old Gallery", address, "Travel Tips" list, "Accessibility" notes — step-free entrance, accessible restrooms, wheelchair access, hearing loop, "Parking & Transport" notes — nearest metro/bus stop, limited street parking, recommend public transport).
Right = an inline SVG (hand-coded, viewBox e.g. 0 0 400 300) mock map containing: a rectangle representing the gallery building block (labeled "THE OLD GALLERY"), a few street lines (simple <line> or <path> elements in muted gold/gray), a metro/bus marker (small circle + "M" or bus glyph label), an entrance marker (small gold pin/circle labeled "Entrance"), and a gold dashed/solid route line (<path> with stroke var gold, stroke-dasharray) connecting the transit marker to the entrance marker. Wrap SVG in a glass panel.

=== 7. TICKET TIERS (#tickets) ===
3 responsive ticket cards (glass panel, premium border, hover lift + gold glow shadow):
Card 1 "Night Pass" — €29 — bullet list: Entry after 19:00 / Main exhibition access / Program access. Button "Select Night Pass".
Card 2 "Curator Pass" — €59 — has a "Recommended" gold ribbon/badge, slightly elevated/scaled — bullets: Everything in Night Pass / Hidden collection tour / Reserved artist talk seating. Button "Select Curator Pass".
Card 3 "Patron Pass" — €129 — bullets: Everything in Curator Pass / VIP lounge access / Signed event print / Priority entrance. Button "Select Patron Pass".
Each "Select" button opens the ticket checkout modal (id="ticketModal") passing tier name + price via JS (data attributes or JS object).

Ticket checkout modal: shows selected tier name + price (read-only, updates if user could switch — a <select> of the 3 tiers pre-set to chosen one is fine), fields: Attendee Name (text, required), Email (email, required, validated with regex + native type=email), Number of Tickets (number input, min=1 max=8, default 1), auto-calculated Total Price (price * quantity, updates live on quantity/tier change via JS input listeners), checkbox "I agree to the terms" (required), "Confirm Reservation" submit button (disabled state style if invalid, but validate on submit is fine too). On submit: run JS validation (name non-empty, email regex valid, quantity within range, checkbox checked) — show inline error messages under invalid fields (no alert()), on success show a success state inside modal ("Reservation Confirmed — check-in at the door with your name") AND trigger a toast notification, then auto-close modal after ~2.5s or on manual close. No real payment/backend — just a client-side mock. Modal closable via close button, ESC, backdrop click, same pattern as artist modal.

=== 8. FAQ (#faq) ===
Accordion with at least 6 Q&A items (button header + collapsible answer panel, aria-expanded toggling, smooth max-height/opacity transition via JS toggling a class, only one open at a time is fine but not required):
- Is payment processed on this page? → No, this is a demo — no real payment is processed.
- Can I arrive late? → answer
- Are photos allowed? → answer
- Is the venue accessible? → answer
- Can I change my ticket tier? → answer
- How do I save the event to my calendar? → mention the Save to Calendar button
(Feel free to add 1-2 more for richness.)

=== 9. NEWSLETTER (#newsletter) ===
Glass panel section: heading, short line, email input + "Subscribe" button in a form (prevent default submit). Inline validation message under input (shows error if invalid email, clears on valid). On valid submit: clear field, show toast "You're on the list.", no backend.

=== 10. FOOTER ===
- ARTIFACT gold logo text
- one-line event credits ("Curated by ... / Produced by ...", invented)
- row of text-style "social links" (e.g. Instagram, X, Newsletter — plain <a href="#"> styled as links, no real URLs needed, just text with hover underline)
- copyright line "© 2026 ARTIFACT: Museum Night. All rights reserved."
- small muted note: "Demo landing page — no real ticket purchase."

=== JAVASCRIPT (inline <script> at end of body, vanilla only) ===
1. Mobile nav toggle open/close + close on link click/outside click.
2. Navbar scroll class toggle (add 'scrolled' class after e.g. 50px scrollY) for background opacity change.
3. Smooth scroll for all in-page nav anchors (also works if browser lacks CSS scroll-behavior support fully).
4. IntersectionObserver over each main section (#hero/#concept/#program/#artists/#venue/#tickets/#faq) to toggle 'active' class on matching nav link.
5. Scroll-reveal: IntersectionObserver adding a 'visible' class to all .reveal elements when they enter viewport (CSS transitions opacity/transform from hidden to shown state); unobserve after reveal.
6. Artist data array (8 objects: name, role, image, bio, time) + modal open/close logic wired to each "View details" button; ESC + backdrop click + close button all close it.
7. Ticket tier select buttons open ticket modal with tier preset; live total price calculation; full validation with inline error messages; success state + toast; auto reset form after close.
8. FAQ accordion toggle logic.
9. Newsletter form validation + toast.
10. Toast notification helper function: creates/reuses a toast container fixed at bottom, shows a message with fade in/out, auto-dismiss after ~3s, supports stacking multiple toasts gracefully.
11. Save to Calendar: on #saveCalendarBtn click, build an ICS string exactly:
"BEGIN:VCALENDAR\nVERSION:2.0\nBEGIN:VEVENT\nSUMMARY:ARTIFACT: Museum Night\nDTSTART:20261018T190000\nDTEND:20261019T020000\nLOCATION:The Old Gallery, Warsaw\nDESCRIPTION:A cinematic after-hours museum event with exhibitions, performances, talks, and guided tours.\nEND:VEVENT\nEND:VCALENDAR"
(use \r\n line endings), create a Blob(type:'text/calendar;charset=utf-8'), create an object URL, create a temporary <a> with download="artifact-museum-night.ics", click it via JS, then revoke the object URL and remove the temp anchor. Must work with no backend.
12. Wrap everything defensively (avoid null-ref errors) so there are zero console errors on load and interaction. Use 'DOMContentLoaded' wrapper or place script at end of body after all elements exist.

=== ACCESSIBILITY / RESPONSIVE / POLISH ===
- All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) have visible :focus-visible outline in gold and hover states.
- Images have descriptive alt text.
- Modals have aria-modal, role=dialog, aria-labelledby pointing to their heading.
- Responsive breakpoints (e.g. @media max-width:900px and max-width:600px) collapsing grids to 1-2 columns, hiding desktop nav in favor of hamburger, stacking hero CTAs/badges, reducing font sizes via clamp() (already fluid) and adjusting paddings.
- Ensure no external JS/CSS files or CDN links are referenced anywhere (fonts are system stacks only) — the only external resources are the unsplash image URLs specified.

Produce the entire HTML document now as the full file content.
"}
